subject: Oakridge: on-prem bundling request — platform fee amortization & support tiers
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakridgehealth.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com; Contracts <contracts@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Packaging ask for on-prem pilot -> multi-site deployment

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our execs liked the performance profile and the idea of a single control plane across our data centers. Procurement asked me to consolidate the ask so you can provide a packaged commercial response. Key bits:

- 3-site private deployment (2 primary DCs + 1 DR)
- Operator licenses for 10 named SREs + 30 inference nodes (mixed GPU sizes)
- Platform fee: they want an amortized option over term (24 vs 36 months) and a discount if we commit the 24-month term
- Support: tiered SLA with a 24/7 oncall retainer (severity 1) and a lower-cost business-hours support for standard incidents
- Implementation milestone: prefer 50% on kickoff, 50% on production signoff

Attached is our SOW template and procurement questionnaire. Can you send a packaged price + recommended amortization approach and any standard concessions you can offer for multi-site pilots?

Tim (cc) will handle contract redlines. Looking for a quick turnaround — ideally by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director of Infrastructure Programs
Oakridge Health

Attachments: Oakridge_SOW_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Oakridge_procurement_qs.pdf (pdf)

From: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Tim Liao <tim.liao@oakridgehealth.com>, Contracts <contracts@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Packaging ask for on-prem pilot -> multi-site deployment

Hi Olivia — great to hear. We can absolutely put together a tailored commercial that maps to your preferred terms. High-level options (summary):

1) 24-month committed model (recommended for pilots that convert to prod)
   - Platform fee amortized monthly over 24 months (preferred pricing): 20% off list platform fee when combined with a 12+ node operator retainer and 24-month term
   - Implementation: 50% kickoff / 50% signoff
   - SRE retainer: flat monthly for 24/7 oncall (listed as a line item)

2) 36-month smoothing model
   - Lower monthly amortization but smaller near-term discount (10% off list)

3) Seat/operator license alternative
   - Option to convert operator licenses to site-level bundles after year 1 with a true-up if usage exceeds thresholds

I'll attach a short pricing summary and a draft MSA redline that aligns to Oakridge procurement notes. Timelines: we can return a formal commercial (SOW + pricing matrix + sample SLA) by end of day Tuesday if that works.

I attached a one-pager (privdeploy-pricing-summary.pdf) and the draft redlines.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: privdeploy-pricing-summary.pdf (pdf), draft-MSA-redlines.docx (docx)

From: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Oakridge packaging ask — pricing/credit ask (internal)

Irene / Marissa — forwarding Oakridge thread. Customer is explicit: 24-month amortization + discount for commitment, 3-site private deployment, operator retainer.

Ask: would finance be comfortable with 20% off platform fee if we amortize over 24 months and accept 50% upfront + 50% on signoff? Also, they want a 24/7 oncall retainer included as a line item (they may ask for it to be partially credited against the platform fee).

Notes / proposed concession I’m considering:
- 15% platform fee discount + ability to defer 30% of platform fee until production signoff if commit to 24 months (this cushions their cashflow)
- Keep SRE retainer fully billable (no offset) but offer first three months at a 50% onboarding discount
- Include a one-time implementation credit (applied against first invoice) if they sign within 10 business days

Could you run a quick P&L on that and confirm margin? We need a firm answer by EOD Monday to hit their turnaround.

Onward,
Lukas

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T14:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oakridge packaging ask — pricing/credit ask (internal)

Lukas — ran the numbers with Finance. Summary:

- Baseline list platform fee for Oakridge sizing (3-site, 30 nodes) -> $1,200,000 / year
- 15% platform discount yields acceptable margin at term lengths >=24 months. 20% would start to get tight against our SRE capacity assumptions unless we reduce scope or require a higher commit.
- Deferral: deferring 30% to signoff is OK, but Finance wants the implementation milestone explicitly tied to measurable acceptance criteria (latency SLA + model conversion checklist).
- SRE retainer: recommend keeping as a separate monthly line item. Offer onboarding discount: 3 months at 50% (as you suggested).
- We can offer a one-time $30k implementation credit if they sign within 10 business days.

If you want to push to 20% discount, we need a stronger commitment: 36-month term or a non-cancellable minimum GPU commitment. Otherwise stick to 15% + deferral + $30k credit.

I'll draft the pricing matrix and revenue waterfall and attach it to the formal commercial.

-Marissa
Head of Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: revenue-waterfall-oakridge.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakridgehealth.com>, Tim Liao <tim.liao@oakridgehealth.com>, Contracts <contracts@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T10:07:00-08:00
Subject: Oakridge commercial proposal (24-month option + onboarding credits)

Hi Olivia / Tim — appreciate the patience. Attached is our formal proposal and a pricing matrix that maps the 24- vs 36-month amortization. Executive summary / counter: 

- Recommended path: 24-month committed term with 15% off the annual platform fee (applies when signed).
- Payment cadence: 50% invoice at kickoff, 30% deferred to production signoff (tied to acceptance criteria in the SOW), remaining 20% invoiced month-by-month across the remainder of the amortization term.
- Implementation credit: $30,000 one-time credit if fully executed within 10 business days of this email.
- SRE retainer: separate monthly line item — first three months at 50% onboarding discount.
- Conversion guardrail: operator license true-up after 12 months if actual usage > 120% of forecast; price for overage at published operator rate.

Attachments include: Oakridge_SOW_v1.xlsx, privdeploy-pricing-summary.pdf, draft-MSA-redlines.docx.

If this aligns I can loop in legal to start tracked redlines and send the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Best,
Lukas

Attachments: Oakridge_SOW_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), privdeploy-pricing-summary.pdf (pdf), draft-MSA-redlines.docx (docx)

From: Tim Liao <tim.liao@oakridgehealth.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge commercial proposal (24-month option + onboarding credits)

Lukas — thanks for the clear package. Procurement has reviewed and we have two quick asks before we finalize: 

1) Can the deferred 30% be capped at a specific milestone acceptance checklist we can agree to (we propose: production traffic switch + latency within 5% of benchmark + SOC2 evidence exchange)?
2) On the SRE retainer: would Redwood consider applying 25% of the onboarding discount as a credit against the first quarterly invoice instead of a wholesale discount? Helps our internal cost centers.

If you can confirm those two items we can push this to legal for final redlines and aim to sign within the 10 business day window.

-Tim
Senior Procurement Manager
Oakridge Health

---
Thread notes: Tim's reply will go into Contracts for redlines. We agreed internally to the 15% discount + $30k credit; the deferred 30% needs explicit acceptance criteria in the SOW (Marissa flagged requirement). Irene — please prep the acceptance checklist and confirm the SOC2 exchange window.
